title: Unit Event — Star of Your Own Story — Episode1 New Worlds Await!

meta.Event Outline: Wonderlands×Showtime have decided to work with other troupes, starting with the long-established Shunmeiza. Given a minor role with just three lines, Tsukasa faces a seemingly impossible task: to convince the director that his character is a real person.

rows.Line: Holiday - Early morning
Nonogi Park

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Pa-pe-pi-pu-pe-po-pa-po!

rows.Speaker: Nene, Rui & Emu
rows.Line: Pa-pe-pi-pu-pe-po-pa-po!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Alright, that's enough warming up!
Let's regroup!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Nod*
What a glorious morning! The perfect backdrop to our departure.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Anyway, are you all ready?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm actually a little nervous. We get to start working with another troupe today...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes.
Robo-Nene will have to stay behind, and we'll need to get used to a drastically different environment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
At the same time...
I really wasn't expecting Shosuke's farewell gift to us to be so spectacular.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I feel the same way regarding that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: He and Keisuke connected us with three different troupes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shunmeiza, with whom we'll be working this time around, along with the Mikazukigumi and Morinomiya troupes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They each have their own distinct styles, but they're all nationally renowned.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's so cool how we get to work with all of them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Not only that, they all agreed to devote time to helping us improve... I honestly couldn't be more grateful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hehe. Me too.
So, starting today, let's learn as much as we can from everyone in Shunmeiza.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Um, so... Shunmeiza's been around for a really, really long time, right?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Correct.
It's been in business ever since before the war, so it has quite an established history.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So much so that one of the big awards for theatrical performances is named after one of its founders.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Is that true?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It consists of about 200 members.
And the number is even higher if you include the directing and production teams that we'll be working with this time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: They have some young actors, but more of them are veterans. Some have even been on TV and in movies, so you might see some familiar faces.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, I've seen a few of them perform in TV dramas... I think that most people would say that Shunmeiza produces a lot of really skilled actors.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's like they all know how to bring their characters to life... They make them feel so real, you know?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: They make their characters feel that real, eh...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I've only seen videos of Shunmeiza's performances...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (But everyone I saw was absolutely spectacular. I couldn't look away for even a second.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (If I can learn how to do what they do, then I'll surely be able to take another big step as an actor.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (So, Tsukasa Tenma, get ready to learn a lot! In order to become a star who makes people smile the world over!)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. He certainly seems ready.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Now, Emu, would you mind doing the usual for us?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah, of course!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
We're gonna practice lots and lots!
We're gonna do lots and lots to make our dreams come true! And we're gonna put lots and lots of wonderhoy smiles on people's faces!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Ready, you guys?! Wonderhoy!!

rows.Speaker: Rui, Nene & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!!
Several dozen minutes later
Shunmeiza - Studio

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Staff Member
rows.Line: The director and cast members will be arriving shortly. Please wait here for them.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes, of course!
Thank you!
se_walk_men_002_1

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
My nerves are beginning to fray. I suppose that's only natural when you're on another troupe's home turf.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Interesting. Even the great Tsukasa gets nervous in these kinds of situations?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Of course I'm nervous!
This is nothing like anything we've done before!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
You're right, it isn't...
Even just this place. It feels completely different from the Wonder Stage.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Also, this isn't called a “stage” or “practice area”, but a “studio”, right? Why is that?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, a “studio” sounds more like either buildings where they make movies or places where painters and sculptors work...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, I would imagine that most others would also think of studios as places like that.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But a studio can actually be any place where a work of art is made. I imagine that that's why they call it that.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
That's actually kinda cool!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
I see...
...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Hm?
Is something the matter, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, it's just...
I didn't realize how so much thought could go into one word...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm starting to feel that we kinda don't belong here...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It feels so...intellectual here...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I see...
Yes, when you put it that way, I somewhat understand...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
But there's no need to fear!
We just need to show everyone that we're intellectual and cool by walking in with our heads held high!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, with our chins way up!
I mean, we have Rui on our side!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Emu, wait...
You're making it sound like Rui's the only one who's smart!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: This is what I meant...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Now now.
I do agree that there's no need for us to worry.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, Shunmeiza's plays aren't quite the same as the shows we put on, but I'm sure they'll welcome us with open arms.
se_event_supporting_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, someone's coming!
se_event_supporting_2023_002

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
Ah, you must be Wonderlands×Showtime.
Apologies for the wait.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(I'm seeing about twenty people.
A surprising number of them are young people.)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (And I have to think this man is the...)

rows.Speaker: Shunmeiza Director
rows.Line:
It's a pleasure to meet you.
My name is Kato. I'm Shunmeiza's director, and I have the great honor of working with all of you starting from today.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This is it! Our new chapter's finally about to begin...!!)
